description: VAN-022 cash reconciliation approval code vectors. TEST-ONLY secret, never a DEV or production value. key = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(secret, 'sunpride/van-cash-approval/v1|' + tripId)) without padding; code = RFC 4226 dynamic truncation of HMAC-SHA256(key bytes, 'CASH|v1|' + tripId + '|' + expectedMinor + '|' + declaredMinor + '|' + reasonCode) mod 10^8, zero-padded to 8 digits.
